Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the ACME platform team was impressed with the latency profile. A quick update from our side: Governance wants this to be a gatekeeper session with Platform, Security, Infrastructure and Procurement present before we can move to a pilot. That means we need a longer slot (90 minutes) and a few different people than the original invite.

Can we please reconvene next week? Our tentative list: Ruth Holden (Security), Marcus Lee (Platform lead), Jenna Park (Infra), and Sandra King (Procurement). Attached is a procurement checklist that procurement asked us to confirm ahead of time.

Thanks,
Ruth

We can do either a single 90-minute slot or split into a 60-minute technical run + 30-minute procurement+commercial sync. If the latter helps stakeholders focus, we can run both back-to-back on our side.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue May 11, 10:00–11:30
- Wed May 12, 13:00–14:30
- Thu May 13, 09:00–10:30

Marissa / Priyom — can you confirm availability for those windows and whether we should prepare an SSO / audit-logging deep dive (we have a short demo and a playbook). I'll draft an agenda and share the agenda PDF here.

Thanks,
